WITH half_season_rates AS (
  SELECT 
    team_id,
    w * 1.0 / g AS win_rate
  FROM manager_half
  WHERE g IS NOT NULL AND g > 0 AND w IS NOT NULL
),
team_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    team_id,
    AVG(win_rate) AS avg_win_rate,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM half_season_rates
  GROUP BY team_id
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_win_rate) AS mean_avg_win_rate
  FROM team_averages
)
SELECT 
  t.team_id,
  t.avg_win_rate,
  t.record_count,
  t.avg_win_rate - o.mean_avg_win_rate AS difference
FROM team_averages t
CROSS JOIN overall_mean o
ORDER BY 
  difference IS NULL,
  difference DESC
LIMIT 10;
